rationale: The kidney stone was pre-existing under wording section 7 and manual section 7: the medical records show a urologist visit on May 14, 2026, a stone seen on CT, and a potassium citrate dose increase with tamsulosin added. All of these fall in the 60 days before the policy was bought on June 20, 2026, and the policy has no Pre-Existing Condition Waiver. Because the records take precedence over the customer's account, the whole $6,200 claim is excluded and the payout is $0.
